prepare_fp8_moe_weights: prepare FP8 MoE weights and scales for FlashInfer TRT-LLM kernels by shuffling and interleaving
prepare_mxfp8_moe_weights: prepare MXFP8 MoE weights and scales with cached row-index transforms for FlashInfer TRT-LLM kernels
run_fp8_moe_forward: run FP8 MoE forward pass with FlashInfer TRT-LLM kernels using block or per-tensor quantization
run_fp4_moe_forward: run FP4 MoE forward pass with FlashInfer TRT-LLM kernels using block scale quantization
run_bf16_moe_forward: run BF16 MoE forward pass with FlashInfer TRT-LLM kernels without quantization
